changelog:
Initial release – export Google Maps business data with flexible formats and CRM integration.

- Export business data from Google Maps to CSV, JSON, or CRM-specific formats (HubSpot, Pipedrive, Salesforce)
- Supports bulk export, custom field mapping, and advanced filtering options
- Simple credit-based system (5 free exports with signup)
- Guided workflow: prompts user for category, location, fields, format, and filters, then confirms before export
- Includes automated format transformation and field mapping for major CRMs
- Allows re-processing of exported data without consuming additional credits
summary: Export Google Maps business data to CSV, JSON, or CRM format (HubSpot, Pipedrive, Salesforce). Bulk export with custom field mapping and filtering.
